This data set contains the two (2) scans of the Kootenai Brown Poplar Grove Cabin Site. The data was collected by the Capture2preserv team on the 27th May 2022 with the GeoSlam Zeb Horizon mobile laser scanner and the FireFly 8SE camera. The data was then processed in the GeoSlam Hub and Connect software.
